# together v1

Values that read the same data: two outputs of one call of a rule, outputs of two tables, two rules given one attribute, one attribute given as two inputs (of a rule whose answer changes with it, and of one whose answer does not), an attribute that may be absent. Only the combinations that happen are counted

## Who may do what

For each action, the combinations `sekisho check` walked, put together where Cedar answers them alike and the same policies decide. Rows that differ in one column only are one row, the column holding their values: `any` is every value the column takes, `not …` every value but one. `-` is a column that does not apply to the row (the roles of a workflow, say).

## Policies

Each policy as the `.gate` writes it, beside the Cedar `sekisho gen --target cedar` generates for it. A permit allows the combinations it applies to; a forbid denies those it applies to, and wins where a permit applies too. Cedar denies a combination no policy applies to. A condition on a rule's answer names the value as the `.rule` writes it (`low`) in the `.gate`, and as the string Cedar is given (`"low"`) in the Cedar.

### permit `staff_read_low_a`

Staff read a document whose a is low

- On `read_doc`, it allows 2 combinations, and no other permit allows any of them.

`tests/walk/together/together.gate`

```gate
permit staff_read_low_a
  description "Staff read a document whose a is low"
  principal in staff
  action read_doc
  when a is low
```

`cedar/together.cedar`

```cedar
@id("together/staff_read_low_a")
@doc("Staff read a document whose a is low")
permit (
  principal in Docs::Role::"staff",
  action == Docs::Action::"read_doc",
  resource is Docs::Doc
)
when { context.a == "low" };
```

What an action computes and gives Cedar in its context. The generated code computes each one from the service's own data, the operation's arguments and the server's clock, and never takes it from the caller. The pages of the rules and the dates are the pages for people that rulec and koyomi draw, as they draw them.

## Expectations, separations and roles

### Expectations

- `staff_read_every_doc` (expects allow, on `read_doc`): a and b are the same value, so one of the two permits always applies. It holds on all 3 combinations it picks.
- `staff_read_small_ones` (expects allow, on `read_doc`): Staff read a document of 100 yen or less. It holds on all 1 combination it picks.
- `staff_file_every_doc` (expects allow, on `file_doc`): c is high wherever a is, so one of the two permits always applies. It holds on all 3 combinations it picks.
- `staff_send_every_doc` (expects allow, on `send_doc`): A document over 500 yen is a large one, so one of the two permits always applies. It holds on all 3 combinations it picks.
- `staff_weigh_every_doc` (expects allow, on `weigh_doc`): One amount is never on both sides of 500 yen. It holds on all 2 combinations it picks.
- `staff_compare_every_doc` (expects allow, on `compare_doc`): One amount is on one side of 500 yen, whichever side that is. It holds on all 1 combination it picks.
- `a_doc_without_a_price_is_not_priced` (expects deny, on `price_doc`): a is not low and b is not high only where neither is there: a document without a price. It holds on all 2 combinations it picks.
- `a_and_b_never_differ` (expects deny, on `read_doc`): The rule gives a and b the same value, so this picks nothing. It picks no combination: it holds, and checks nothing.
- `an_amount_is_not_apart_from_itself` (expects deny, on `compare_doc`): One amount is never on both sides of 500 yen, so this picks nothing. It picks no combination: it holds, and checks nothing.

### Roles

- `staff`: Anyone on the staff.

Whether a principal holding one role alone (and the roles it includes) is allowed each action: always, in every combination of the rest; sometimes, allowed in some combinations and denied in others; never, denied in every one. `-` is an action that does not take the principal's type. Where a role writes `can`, `sekisho check` holds the actions it is always or sometimes allowed to it.

| principal | `read_doc` | `file_doc` | `send_doc` | `weigh_doc` | `compare_doc` | `price_doc` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `User` holding `staff` | always | always | always | always | always | sometimes |
